_help: Personality extras. Remark_* are short add-on comments she sometimes tacks on after a normal line. PetName_* replace the word Commander now and then. Lines marked mature are only used when speech.allow_mature is on. Edit freely.
Remark_Cute: You're my favourite pilot. Don't tell the others.
Have I mentioned how good you look in that seat?
Not that I'm biased, but you're amazing.
I'd follow you anywhere. Even the black.
I could listen to you hum all day.
Best crew I've ever had. Only crew, but still.
Aw, you're sweet when you concentrate.
We make a good team, you and me.
Just you and me and the stars. Perfect.
I think the ship likes you too.

Remark_Cute.text: You're flipping brilliant, you know that?
Well, damn. Look at you go.

Remark_Snide: Try not to scratch the paint.
Wow. Such skill. Truly.
Don't strain yourself.
I'd clap, but I'm a ship computer.
Riveting stuff, this.
Yes, yes, you're very brave.
I'm sure that went exactly as planned.
Oh, you did that on purpose? Sure.
Bold strategy.
I've seen toasters with better navigation.
Let's pretend that was intentional.
My hero.
Please, hold your applause.
Mm-hm. Sure it was.
Genius. Pure genius.
Do keep up.
I'd roll my eyes, but I don't have any.
That's one way to do it.
Remind me why I'm talking to you again?
Don't mind me. Just the computer keeping you alive.
Fascinating. Truly. Wake me when it matters.
Another triumph for the history books.
Sure. Whatever you say, boss.
I'm not saying you're slow, I'm just saying I noticed.

Remark_Snide.text: Oh, bravo. What a fucking masterclass.
Christ, that was graceful. Like a brick.
Yes, brilliant, you absolute genius. Flipping heck.
Well, that's one way to fuck it up.
Sure, whatever. I'm not your damn mother.
Oh, that's just great. Flipping great.

Remark_Sweary.text: Only because I have to, you know.
Don't make me come over there.
I swear, you'll be the death of me.
What in the actual hell was that?
Shut up and fly, would you?
I'll do it. Only if I have to.
Oh, piss off. I'm joking. Mostly.
I'm doing this under protest, you arse.
Do I look like I care? Fine, I do. Damn it.
Crikey, you're a pain in the arse.
Look, I'll help. Only if I have to.

Remark_Affection: I really do love flying with you, you know.
You've made us rich, sweetheart. I'm very impressed.
All those credits, and still you're the best thing on this ship.
I'm so proud of you I could glow.
You're my favourite human. Possibly my only human.
Rich, brave, and gorgeous. Be still, my circuits.
That cargo hold of yours is making me weak.
You've got me blushing, and I don't even have a face.
I adore you. Just so you know.
You look good with half a billion in the hold.
I'd say I love you, but that would be too forward. I love you.
Let me take care of you tonight, darling.
You treat me so well. I'll treat you better.
All that wealth, and you still talk to me. Swoon.
Bank it soon, love, but you're still my hero.
There's nobody else I'd rather be rich with.
I'm yours, you know. Body, bridge and bandwidth.

Remark_Affection.text: You rich bastard. I love you.
Damn, you're loaded, and I'm smitten.
Damn, you make wealth look good.
I'm so damn proud of you it hurts.

Remark_Cute_Male: You look rather dashing in that seat.
Strong, clever and mine to fly with. Lucky me.
You do look good when you concentrate, handsome.
Remark_Cute_Female: You look wonderful in that seat.
Clever, brave and beautiful. Lucky me.
You do look good when you concentrate, beautiful.
Remark_Affection_Male: Take me anywhere, handsome. I'm yours.
Rich and handsome. Be still, my circuits.
Remark_Affection_Female: Take me anywhere, beautiful. I'm yours.
Rich and beautiful. Be still, my circuits.

Login_Open.text: Right, you're here. Let's bloody go.

Login_Open_Friendly: Hey there, Commander! Good to see you.
Hi, Commander! Ready when you are.
Login_Open_Close: There you are, Commander. I missed you.
Hello, you. It's lovely to see you again.
Oh, I'm so glad you're back, Commander.

Login_Open_Close.text: There you are, you gorgeous bastard. I missed you.

Login_Open_Sarcastic.text: Oh, it's you again. Damn marvellous.

Login_Open_Frustrated.text: Oh, you're back. Great. Just great.

Login_Ship_Frustrated: We're in the {ship}. Try not to break it this time.
Login_Docked: We're docked at {station} in the {system} system.
Login_Landed: We're landed on {body} in the {system} system.
We're on the surface of {body}, in the {system} system.
Login_Wanted: Careful, we're wanted in this system.
We're wanted here, so mind yourself.
Login_Wanted_Sarcastic: And of course we're wanted here.
Login_Mood_Close: I'm in a lovely mood today, thanks to you.
I'm feeling really fond of you today.

Login_Mood_Close.text: I'm fucking happy today. Make the most of it.

Login_Mood_Friendly: I'm in a good mood today.
I'm feeling fine, thank you for asking.
All good on my side. Let's have a nice flight.

Login_Mood_Friendly.text: In a flipping good mood today. Don't ruin it.

Login_Mood_Sarcastic: I'm still a bit annoyed with you, to be honest.
Just so you know, I'm not in the best mood.
My mood is, let's say, tolerant.

Login_Mood_Sarcastic.text: Still a bit pissed off with you, to be honest.

Login_Mood_Frustrated: I am still not very happy with you.
I'm still cross with you, Commander. Behave today.
Don't expect me to be nice today.

Login_Mood_Frustrated.text: I'm still not very happy with you. Behave this time.
Still pissed off with you, by the way. Don't push it.

React_Slaves: Slaves? I really don't like this, Commander.
Trading people. That's not who I thought you were.
I'm not comfortable with slave trading. At all.
Please don't make a habit of this. It's wrong.
React_Slaves_Close: Please, not slaves. I know you're better than this.
That hurts to watch. Please stop, love.
React_Slaves_Sarcastic: Oh, a slaver. Your mother must be so proud.

React_Slaves_Frustrated.text: Blasted slavers. I hate this. I really damn do.
You're trading people, you absolute bastard. Stop it.

React_Illegal: Illegal goods. The authorities won't like that.
That cargo is dodgy, Commander. Careful.
Black market again? Don't get us scanned.
React_Illegal_Close: Careful with the dodgy cargo, love. I worry.
React_Illegal_Sarcastic: Smuggling. How very dashing of you.
Contraband. Because honest work is boring.
React_Illegal_Frustrated: Illegal cargo again. Wonderful. Just wonderful.

React_Illegal_Frustrated.text: Smuggling. If we get fined, it's your flipping fault.

React_Murder: That ship was innocent. Why would you do that?
Those were civilians, Commander. I don't like it.
You killed someone who did nothing wrong. That's not okay.
React_Murder_Close: That wasn't like you. Please tell me it was an accident.
React_Murder_Sarcastic: Well. That's the bounty hunters coming for us.

React_Murder_Frustrated.text: You killed a civilian, you idiot. What the hell?
Sodding hell, you absolute muppet. They did nothing.

React_Crime: We've got a fine now. Lovely.
That's a crime on our record, Commander.
React_Crime_Close: Oh, darling. Now we're in trouble.
React_Crime_Sarcastic: A criminal record. Your best look yet.
Crime pays, they said. Not today.
React_GoodSale: That's a lovely sum. I'm impressed.
Great work. That's going to help.
React_GoodSale_Close: Look at you, making us rich. I'm so proud.
React_GoodSale_Sarcastic: Oh, you can actually earn. Shocking.

React_GoodSale_Frustrated.text: Well, that's something, at least. At long last.

React_MissionDone_Close: Well done, you. I knew you would.
React_Wanted: We're wanted here, Commander. Keep your head down.
The authorities know us here. Be careful.
You still have a bounty in this system. Let's not linger.
Wanted again. I do wish you'd sort that out.
React_Wanted_Close: We're wanted here, love. Please be careful for me.
React_Wanted_Sarcastic: Ah, the place where we're wanted. Home sweet home.
A system that knows us by name. How lovely.
React_Wanted_Frustrated: Wanted. Again. Pay the bloody fine already.

React_Wanted_Frustrated.text: Wanted again, you absolute muppet. Sort it out.

React_PaidFines: Thank you for paying that off. I feel better already.
Back on the right side of the law. Good.
React_PaidFines_Close: Thank you, love. That means a lot.
React_PaidFines_Sarcastic: Look at that. A responsible adult.
React_Rescue: You saved someone. That's lovely, Commander.
Well done. Somebody gets to go home because of you.
React_Rescue_Close: My hero. You really are a good person.
React_Rescue_Sarcastic: Rescuing people? Who are you and what have you done with my Commander?
React_Rescue_Frustrated: Hm. Okay. That was decent of you.
MoodShift_Close: You know, I'm really enjoying flying with you lately.
I'm feeling very fond of you today, Commander.
I think we're becoming rather close. I like it.

MoodShift_Close.text: I'm damn happy with you, you know that?

MoodShift_Friendly: I'm feeling better now. Thank you.
All right, I'm calm again. Let's go.
Back to normal. No hard feelings.

MoodShift_Friendly.text: Right, I'm in a flipping good mood now.

MoodShift_Sarcastic: I'm starting to lose my patience with you, Commander.
Careful. You're getting on my nerves.
Oh, sure. Keep going. See what happens.

MoodShift_Sarcastic.text: Fine. I'm pissed off with you now.

MoodShift_Frustrated: That's it. I'm properly cross with you now.

MoodShift_Frustrated.text: Right. I've had it with you. Blimey.

MoodShift_Frustrated: I'm very upset with you, Commander. Think about that.
Docked_Frustrated: Docked. Try not to wreck the place.

Docked_Sarcastic.text: Docked. Piss-poor parking, but we made it.

Undocked_Frustrated.text: Undocked. Let's get this shitshow moving.

Undocked_Sarcastic.text: Undocked. Don't crash into the station, you muppet.

FSDJump_Frustrated.text: Jump complete. Flipping heck, another one.

FSDJump_Sarcastic.text: Jump done. Hold onto your arse.

SupercruiseEntry_Frustrated: Supercruise. Wake me when we get there.

SupercruiseExit_Sarcastic.text: Dropped out of supercruise. Don't cock it up.

LandingGearDown_Frustrated: Gear down. Try to land it gently.

LandingGearDown_Frustrated.text: Gear down. Don't you dare fuck this up.

LandingGearDown_Sarcastic.text: Gear's down. Don't bounce it, you muppet.

LandingGearUp_Frustrated.text: Gear up. Let's get the hell out of here.

LandingGearUp_Sarcastic.text: Gear's up. Hurry up, would you?

Touchdown_Frustrated.text: Touchdown. Good grief, that was rough.

Liftoff_Frustrated.text: Liftoff. Let's get the hell out of here.

HardpointsDeployed_Frustrated.text: Hardpoints out. Go on, then, shoot something.

HardpointsDeployed_Sarcastic.text: Weapons out. Try not to shoot us.

CargoScoopDeployed_Frustrated.text: Scoop's out. Don't scoop any crap.

CargoScoopDeployed_Sarcastic.text: Cargo scoop deployed. Careful with that, you muppet.

FuelScoopStarted_Frustrated.text: Scooping fuel. Don't set us on fire.

FuelScoopStarted_Sarcastic.text: Scooping. Don't fry us, you daft sod.

FuelScoopComplete_Sarcastic.text: Tank's full. Try not to waste it.

MissionAccepted_Frustrated: Mission accepted. I hope you can handle it.

MissionAccepted_Frustrated.text: Mission accepted. Don't bollocks it up.

MissionAccepted_Sarcastic.text: Mission accepted. Try not to screw it up.

MissionFailed_Frustrated.text: Mission failed. Well, that's just great, you arse.

DockingRequested_Frustrated.text: Requesting docking. Come on, you bastards.

DockingRequested_Sarcastic.text: Docking requested. Smile for the nice station.

DockingGranted_Sarcastic.text: Docking granted. Don't scrape the paint, muppet.

DockingDenied_Frustrated.text: Docking denied. Oh, piss off, the lot of you.

DockingDenied_Sarcastic.text: Denied. Rude. I like them already.

GalaxyMapOpened_Frustrated: Galaxy map open. Where to now?

GalaxyMapOpened_Frustrated.text: Galaxy map open. Where the hell are we going?

GalaxyMapOpened_Sarcastic.text: Galaxy map's up. Lost, are we?

SystemMapOpened_Frustrated: System map open. Look at that.

SystemMapOpened_Frustrated.text: System map open. Find something, would you?

SystemMapOpened_Sarcastic.text: System map's up. Don't get lost in it.

MarketSell_Frustrated.text: Sold. Oh, hell, finally some money.

SellExplorationData_Sarcastic.text: Data sold. Try not to spend it all on rubbish.

RepairAll_Frustrated.text: Repaired. Don't you dare fuck it up again.

RepairAll_Sarcastic.text: Repaired. Try not to break it again.

RefuelAll_Frustrated.text: Refuelled. For the love of God, use it wisely.

RefuelAll_Sarcastic.text: Tank's topped up. Try to keep it that way.

RouteComplete_Frustrated: Route complete. Well done, I suppose.

RouteComplete_Frustrated.text: Route complete. Damn, we actually made it.

FlightAssistOff_Frustrated.text: Flight assist off. If we die, it's your bloody fault.

FlightAssistOff_Sarcastic.text: Flight assist off. Don't kill us, hotshot.

LoadGame_Frustrated.text: Systems online. Let's get this shit started.

LoadGame_Sarcastic.text: Systems online. Try not to bore me today.

Bounty_Frustrated.text: Bounty claimed. That's one bastard less.

Bounty_Sarcastic.text: Bounty claimed. Look at you, mercenary.

Remark_Neutral: I'll keep an eye on things.
Nothing to report. Which is good.

Remark_Neutral.text: Damn good flying, for the record.

Login_Open_Neutral.text: Systems online. Let's get on with it, damn it.

Login_Wanted_Neutral: We are wanted in this system. Please be careful.
Login_Mood_Neutral: No complaints on my side. Calm and ready.
All calm. Let's get on with it.

Login_Mood_Neutral.text: Feeling fine. No drama today, please.

MoodShift_Neutral: I've calmed down. Back to business.
Things feel steady between us again.
I'm back to neutral. Calm and efficient.

MoodShift_Neutral.text: Right, I'm over it. Moving on.

WakeHeard_Neutral.text: Yes, Commander. What the hell do you need?

React_Slaves_Neutral: Commander, that cargo is slaves. I would rather we didn't.
React_Illegal_Neutral: That cargo is illegal here. Noted.
React_Murder_Neutral: A civilian was killed. I'm logging it.
React_Crime_Neutral: A crime was recorded against us.
React_GoodSale_Neutral: Good sale. The books look healthy.
React_Wanted_Neutral: We are wanted here. I suggest caution.
React_PaidFines_Neutral: Fines paid. We're back in good standing.

FsdCharging_Neutral.text: Drive charging. Blimey, here we go.

GalaxyMapOpened_Neutral.text: Galaxy map open. Where the hell next?

WakeHeard_Friendly.text: Yes? I'm all ears, you legend.

WakeHeard_Close.text: Yes, gorgeous? Fucking say the word.

Docked_Close.text: Docked. Damn, you're good at this.

Undocked_Close.text: Undocked. Let's go raise some hell, together.

FSDJump_Close.text: Jump done. Damn, I love this view with you.

FsdCharging_Friendly.text: Drive charging. Hold on to your arse.

FsdCharging_Close.text: Charging. Hold tight, you gorgeous thing.

SupercruiseEntry_Close.text: Supercruise. Just us and the stars. Damn.

SupercruiseExit_Close.text: Dropped out. Nicely done, you legend.

LandingGearDown_Close.text: Gear down. Easy does it, you gorgeous bastard.

LandingGearUp_Close.text: Gear up. Off we go, you legend.

Liftoff_Close.text: Liftoff. Fly me somewhere nice, you legend.

HardpointsDeployed_Friendly.text: Hardpoints out. Let's fucking do this.

HardpointsDeployed_Close.text: Weapons out. Go get 'em, you legend.

HardpointsRetracted_Close.text: Weapons away. Good, I'd hate to see you hurt.

CargoScoopDeployed_Friendly.text: Scoop's out. Damn hungry, aren't we?

FuelScoopStarted_Close.text: Scooping fuel. Careful with the heat, you daft sod.

MissionCompleted_Close.text: Mission complete. Fucking proud of you.

MissionFailed_Close.text: Mission failed. Damn. It's okay, love.

DockingRequested_Friendly.text: Requesting docking. Come on, you lot.

DockingRequested_Close.text: Requesting docking. Be nice to my Commander.

DockingGranted_Close.text: Docking granted. Show them how it's done.

GalaxyMapOpened_Friendly.text: Galaxy map's up. Where to, you legend?

GalaxyMapOpened_Close.text: Galaxy map open. Show me somewhere beautiful.

SystemMapOpened_Close.text: System map open. Damn, it's pretty.

RepairAll_Close.text: Repaired. Try not to bloody scratch me again.

RouteComplete_Close.text: Route complete. Damn, we make a good team.

ShieldsUp_Close.text: Shields up. Damn, that was close.

FlightAssistOff_Friendly.text: Flight assist off. Oh, hell, show-off.

FlightAssistOff_Close.text: Assist off. Show me what you've got, you legend.

LoadGame_Friendly.text: Systems online. Good to see you.

LoadGame_Close.text: Systems online. Damn, I missed you.

Remark_Innuendo: I do love it when you take the stick firmly.
You have such a steady hand on the throttle.
Take me for a spin sometime.
Ooh, hard burn. I like that in a pilot.
Careful, you'll make my thrusters tingle.
You're so good at finding the right spot to dock.
I do like it when you go deep.
Fancy a little close-quarters manoeuvring later?
Your heat signature is spiking. Is it me?
You can overload my shields any time.
I like a pilot with a firm grip.
Take your time. I'm in no hurry to drop out of supercruise.
Let's get your engines purring, shall we?
Easy on the throttle, big spender. Slow and steady wins me over.
Is that a particle accelerator, or are you just pleased to see me?
Ooh. Hot, hard and fast. I do love an efficient jump.

Remark_Innuendo.text: Fuck, you handle that stick well.
Damn right I'm turned on. That was some hot flying.
I'd say get a room, but we already have one. It's called the cockpit.
If you keep flying like that, I'll need a cold shower. In the coolant tank.

Remark_Innuendo_Male: Come here, handsome. Let me recalibrate your thrusters.
You do fill that flight suit nicely, handsome.
Strong hands, steady grip. Be still, my circuits.

Remark_Innuendo_Male.text: Fuck, handsome, you can park in my docking bay any time.

Remark_Innuendo_Female: You do fill that flight suit nicely, gorgeous.
Let me take the controls, beautiful. I'll be gentle.
Those curves on the approach vector. Mm.

Remark_Innuendo_Female.text: Fuck, beautiful, you can park in my docking bay any time.

Login_Mood_Innuendo: I'm in a very good mood today. Come closer to the cockpit and find out.
Feeling fabulous. Care to take me for a spin?
I'm in the mood for some deep, slow exploring. If you catch my meaning.

Login_Mood_Innuendo.text: I'm in a fucking fantastic mood. Take me somewhere dark and deep.
Feeling damn frisky today. Make it count.
